job: Go to a page by keyboard and list every shortcut in a sheet.
purpose: Keys are data attributes on controls: data-fd-keys="g l" on a link makes G then L follow it, "/" opens search, "?" opens the sheet. While the first key waits, nav items show their key and a hint says a key is expected. The sheet is a dialog filled from the page each time it opens, so it never lists a key that does nothing.
useWhen: People return to the same few pages all day: an app with a sidebar of destinations.
A product has several shortcuts and needs one place that lists them.

avoidWhen.when: Jumping to anything by typing, including records.
A shortcut hint on one control.

states.name: waiting
states.how: data-fd-keys-pending="g" on <html> for 1.6 seconds after the first key; the hint shows data-state="open"

states.name: skipped
states.how: no key works in a field, in a modal, with Ctrl, Cmd or Alt, or on a hidden or disabled control

parts.role: The sheet's list, filled from the page.
One shortcut: its name and its keys.
The status line shown while a key waits for its second.

keyboard.does: Follows the control that carries that sequence.
Drops a first key that is waiting.
